executiveSummary: All 4 user stories and 5 functional requirements for iteration it_000035 are fully implemented and verified. The `nvst init` command correctly delegates scope selection to `npx skills add`, passes the bundled `nvst-skills` path, awaits completion before reporting success, and handles abort cleanly. The `tmpl_` skill files have been migrated out of `scaffold/.agents/skills/` (directory no longer exists) and are available as proper SKILL.md entries under `nvst-skills/`. All 16 dedicated tests pass and typecheck returns clean.
minorObservations: In `defaultInitDeps.skillsInstallerFn`, when `process.stdin.isTTY` is false the installer is silently skipped (returns 0). This is a pragmatic guard for CI/automated contexts but is undocumented; maintainers running nvst init non-interactively may not expect this behaviour.

US-003-AC04 delegates idempotency entirely to the `skills` package by always invoking the installer on re-runs. No runtime guard exists if the `skills` package itself is not idempotent — intentional per Non-Goals but worth noting.
The `scaffold/.agents/skills/` directory has been fully removed (not just emptied), which satisfies US-004-AC02 cleanly.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: The implementation fully satisfies the PRD. No corrective action is required. Minor recommendations: (1) document the TTY-skip behaviour in CLI help or README; (2) add an inline comment in init.ts explaining the idempotency contract delegated to the `skills` package.
